_comment: Layer 2 of entity resolution: hand-written decisions, name as written (case-insensitive) -> entity key.
They are applied BEFORE the automatic rules, so a person's decision always wins. Use them to join names
the text never links, or to keep apart names the automatic rules would merge.
An acronym defined in brackets, e.g. 'Transport Layer Security (TLS)', is harvested automatically by layer 1
and does not belong here. Initials alone are not evidence: in this corpus 'waf' has the initials of
'aws well-architected framework' and 'ip' those of 'internet paths' - both wrong.
2026-09-25  Amazon VPC kept apart from 'virtual private cloud (VPC)'. Amazon VPC is the service; a VPC is
a resource created with it - the same distinction as Shield vs Shield Advanced. The automatic
rules had merged them via the 'Amazon' prefix and the harvested acronym 'VPC'.
applied after the automatic rules, entity key -> entity key. Each was labelled by a person;
similarity scores cannot decide them (a DIFFERENT pair scored 0.946, above 11 SAME pairs).
2026-09-25  'keep_apart': the 2 proposals labelled DIFFERENT; layer 3 never proposes them again.
